# openwrt_uhttpd (Resource)

Manages OpenWrt uHTTPd web server settings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Instance name (e.g., 'main').

### Optional

- `cert` (String) HTTPS certificate path.
- `cgi_prefix` (String) CGI handler prefix.
- `home` (String) Document root directory.
- `http_keepalive` (Number) HTTP keepalive timeout.
- `key` (String) HTTPS private key path.
- `listen_http` (List of String) HTTP listen addresses (e.g., ['0.0.0.0:80', '[::]:80']).
- `listen_https` (List of String) HTTPS listen addresses (e.g., ['0.0.0.0:443', '[::]:443']).
- `lua_prefix` (String) Lua CGI handler prefix.
- `max_connections` (Number) Maximum connections.
- `max_requests` (Number) Maximum concurrent requests.
- `network_timeout` (Number) Network timeout in seconds.
- `redirect_https` (Boolean) Redirect HTTP to HTTPS.
- `rfc1918_filter` (Boolean) Filter requests to private IP ranges.
- `script_timeout` (Number) CGI script timeout in seconds.
- `tcp_keepalive` (Number) TCP keepalive.
- `ubus_prefix` (String) Ubus API prefix.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: uhttpd/main.
